'''Tinnel IV''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tinnel system/Legends|Tinnel system]] on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], and the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Quanta sector/Legends|Quanta sector]].

At some point prior to the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a civil war was fought on Tinnel IV in which weapons of mass destruction turned its capital into a smoking crater. The ruins of the capital were afterwards known only as "[[The Abyss (Tinnel IV)|The Abyss]]". An individual affiliated with one of the two sides of the galactic conflict would later explore these ruins.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Into the Abyss}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod's]] private estate was located in the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Val Denn/Legends|Val Denn]].

Tinnel IV was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Falback Kord]].<ref name="ItSoY2" />
